label: Double Red
source_name: Okaloosa County Beach Safety / Destin Fire Control District
method: Synchronized Destin-Fort Walton Beach warning flag; Okaloosa County, City of Destin and Henderson Beach State Park use a common flag selection
flag_schema: Florida Beach Warning Flag terminology v1
flag_terms_note: Official current wording is normalized as: Water Closed to Public=Double Red; High Hazard or High Surf and/or Currents=Red; Medium/Moderate Hazard or Moderate Surf and/or Currents=Yellow; Low Hazard or Calm Conditions, Exercise Caution=Green; Dangerous Marine Life=Purple. Purple is an independent overlay. Forecast rip-current risk is not converted into a flag.
